title: The x-coordinate recurrence xₙ₊₂ = 6xₙ₊₁ − xₙ
content: negPellSeq_fst_rec decouples the first coordinate from the parent's coupled vector recurrence. Expanding two steps — xₙ₊₂ = 3xₙ₊₁ + 4yₙ₊₁ then substituting xₙ₊₁ = 3xₙ + 4yₙ and yₙ₊₁ = 2xₙ + 3yₙ — the yₙ terms cancel against 6xₙ₊₁ − xₙ, leaving a pure scalar order-2 recurrence. The whole proof is `simp only [negPellSeq_succ]; ring`: one unfolding of the parent's definition and a ring identity. Eliminating one variable from a first-order 2D system raises the order to 2, exactly the dimension of the state.

title: The same recurrence for y — Cayley–Hamilton in action
content: negPellSeq_snd_rec proves yₙ₊₂ = 6yₙ₊₁ − yₙ, the identical recurrence. Both coordinates obey it because each is a linear functional of the matrix-power orbit Mⁿ applied to the seed, and Cayley–Hamilton annihilates M by its characteristic polynomial: M² − (tr M)M + (det M)I = M² − 6M + I = 0, i.e. M² = 6M − I. The recurrence coefficients (6, 1) are therefore (tr M, det M) for M = [[3,4],[2,3]], not arbitrary constants.

title: Recurrence + seeds (1,7) determine the x-sequence
content: negPellSeq_fst_unique shows the order-2 recurrence together with the two initial values u₀ = 1, u₁ = 7 pins down the first coordinate completely: any integer sequence with these seeds and the recurrence equals (negPellSeq n).1 everywhere. The proof is a two-step induction that strengthens the goal to track the consecutive pair (uₙ, uₙ₊₁); the step rewrites uₙ₊₂ by the recurrence, substitutes both inductive hypotheses, and closes with negPellSeq_fst_rec. The base case matches the seeds by kernel decide.

title: Recurrence + seeds (1,5) determine the y-sequence
content: negPellSeq_snd_unique is the companion: the same recurrence with seeds u₀ = 1, u₁ = 5 determines the second coordinate. That both coordinates satisfy one recurrence and differ only in initial data is the structural punchline — the recurrence is a property of the transfer matrix (its characteristic polynomial), shared by every linear functional of the orbit, while the seeds select which functional. The chain is thus fully described without reference to the original Diophantine equation x² − 2y² = −1.

title: Convergents of √2 generated by the recurrence
content: The sanity checks trace the chain (1,1) → (7,5) → (41,29) → (239,169) and confirm the recurrence on concrete values: 41 = 6·7 − 1, 239 = 6·41 − 7, 29 = 6·5 − 1, 169 = 6·29 − 5. These coordinate sequences are exactly the numerators 1,7,41,239,… and denominators 1,5,29,169,… of the continued-fraction convergents of √2 with p² − 2q² = −1, so the single recurrence uₙ₊₂ = 6uₙ₊₁ − uₙ generates the best rational approximations to √2 by integer arithmetic alone.
